components.note: 钅 (metal, from 金) — marks metals, as in 钱 money, 银 silver, 钢 steel; 铁 is iron.
失 (shī) is only a loose hint for tiě.
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talk and questions, as in 说, 问, 请; 询 is to ask.
旬 (xún) gives the sound exactly: 询 xún.
钅 (metal, from 金) — marks metals, as in 钱, 铁, 银; 销 first meant melting metal, then to sell off.
肖 (xiāo) gives the sound exactly: 销 xiāo, also in 消 xiāo and 宵 xiāo.
口 (mouth) — marks speech and mouths, as in 叫, 问, 吃; selling is done with talk, as in 出售.
行 (xíng) is a loose hint for héng; 衡 means balance, as in 平衡.
鱼 (fish) — marks fish and sea creatures, as in 鲜, 鲸 whale, 鳄 crocodile; 鲨 is a shark.
沙 (shā) gives the sound exactly: 鲨 shā.
鱼 (fish) — a picture of a fish: head on top, scaly body 田, tail 一. As a radical (鱼) it marks fish, as in 鲨, 鲜.
口 (mouth) — marks the mouth and lips, as in 吃, 喝, 吹; 吻 is a kiss.
勿 (wù) is a loose hint for wěn; 物 wù shares the part.
乘 (chéng) — to ride; as a part it sounds out 剩 shèng.
君 (jūn) hints at the sound: 群 qún is close, as in 裙 qún.
羊 (sheep) — sheep gather in flocks, hence group; the radical also appears in 美 beautiful, 善 good.
阝 (hill, from 阜) with 月 — the shady side of a hill, the opposite of 阳 (阝 with 日, sunny); yīn is the dark principle.
口 (mouth) — marks the mouth and throat, as in 吃, 咽, 喝; 喉 is the throat.
侯 (hóu) gives the sound exactly: 喉 hóu, also in 猴 hóu.
口 (mouth) — marks the mouth and throat, as in 吃, 咽, 喝; 咙 is the throat (喉咙).
龙 (lóng) gives the sound exactly: 咙 lóng, also in 聋 lóng and 笼 lóng.
两 (liǎng) — two, a pair; as a part it sounds out 辆 liàng and 俩 liǎ.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拿, 提; 措 is to handle or arrange.
昔 (xī) is a loose hint for cuò; 错 cuò shares it.
目 (eye) — marks eyes and seeing, as in 看, 眼, 睡; 瞄 is to aim.
苗 (miáo) gives the sound exactly: 瞄 miáo, also in 描 miáo.
唐 (táng) — the Tang dynasty; as a part it sounds out 糖 táng and 塘 táng.
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talk and news, as in 说, 话, 讲; 讯 is a message or an inquiry.
卂 (xùn) gives the sound exactly: 讯 xùn, also in 迅 xùn.
弓 (bow) — marks bows and stretching, as in 张, 引, 弯; 弥 is to fill or extend.
尔 (ěr) is only a loose hint for mí.
辶 (movement) — marks walking and roads, as in 过, 进, 送; 连 is vehicles 车 moving in a line, joined together.
车 (cart) — the vehicle in the chain, as in 转, 轮; 链 liàn (chain) is built on 连.
衣 (clothing) — marks clothes and wrapping, as in 衬, 装, 袋; in 裹 the 衣 literally wraps around 果.
果 (guǒ) gives the sound exactly: 裹 guǒ.
氵 (water) — marks water and rivers, as in 河, 海; 源 is the spring where water starts.
原 (yuán) gives the sound exactly: 源 yuán, also in 愿 yuàn.
毛 (fur) — marks hair and wool, as in 羽, 毯 itself; 毯 is a woollen rug.
炎 (yán) is a loose hint for tǎn; 谈 tán and 淡 dàn share it.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 提; 扔 is to throw.
乃 (nǎi) is only a loose sound hint for rēng.
衤 (clothing) — marks clothes, as in 衬, 衫, 裤; 裸 is to be unclothed.
果 (guǒ) hints at the sound: 裸 luǒ is close, as in 课 kè and 颗 kē.
阝 (hill, from 阜) — marks mounds and the ground, as in 院, 阶, 防; 阱 is a pit dug in the earth.
井 (jǐng) gives the sound exactly: 阱 jǐng, and 井 is a well, itself a pit.
亻 (person) — marks people and their actions, as in 你, 做; 伪 is a person acting a part: fake.
为 (wéi) hints at the sound: 伪 wěi is close.
宀 (roof) — a house, as in 家, 安, 室; 宴 is a feast at home.
妟 (yàn) gives the sound exactly: 宴 yàn.
宀 (roof) — a house or building, as in 家, 安, 室; 宫 is a palace, a grand house.
攵 (tap, strike) — marks actions, as in 教, 改, 放; 散 is to scatter (sàn) or to be loose (sǎn).
女 (woman) — marks women, as in 妈, 姐, 好; 妆 is make-up.
丬 (a form of 爿) hints at the sound: 妆 zhuāng, close to 壮 zhuàng, 状 zhuàng and 装 zhuāng.
卑 (bēi) — humble; as a part it sounds out 碑 bēi, 脾 pí and 牌 pái.
阝 (town, from 邑) on the right — marks places, as in 都, 邮, 邻; 鄙 was a remote town, hence rustic, mean.
啚 (tú) is only a loose hint for bǐ.
宀 (roof) — a house, as in 家, 安, 室; 宽 is a roomy house, hence wide and generous.
心 (heart) — marks feelings, as in 想, 思, 意; 恕 is a forgiving heart.
如 (rú) is a loose hint for shù.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — the body-part radical, as in 脸, 腿, 脑; 脆 is brittle, crisp.
危 (wēi) is a loose hint for cuì.
弓 (bow) — marks bows and bending, as in 弯, 引, 张, 强; 弱 doubles the shape and pairs with 强 strong.
日 (sun) — marks light and warmth, as in 晴, 暗, 暖; 暖 is sunny warmth.
爰 (yuán) is a loose hint for nuǎn; 缓 huǎn and 援 yuán share it.
王 (jade, 玉旁) — marks jade and gems, as in 球, 玩, 理; 珠 is a pearl or bead.
朱 (zhū) gives the sound exactly: 珠 zhū, also in 株 zhū and 蛛 zhū.
片 (slice, plank) — marks flat pieces and wooden boards, as in 牌 sign; 版 is a printing block.
反 (fǎn) hints at the sound: 版 bǎn is close, as in 板 bǎn and 饭 fàn.
王 (jade, 玉旁) — marks jade and gems, as in 球, 珠, 理; 玫 was a red gem, now part of 玫瑰 rose.
攵 (strike) hints at the sound méi, as in 枚 méi.
王 (jade, 玉旁) — marks jade and gems, as in 球, 珠, 玫; 瑰 is a gem, now part of 玫瑰 rose.
鬼 (guǐ) hints at the sound: 瑰 guī is close, as in 魁 kuí and 愧 kuì.
山 (mountain) — marks hills and heights, as in 岛, 峰, 岸; 崇 is lofty, then esteemed.
宗 (zōng) is a loose hint for chóng; 综 zōng and 踪 zōng share it.
力 (strength) — marks effort and work, as in 动 move, 努 strive, 办; 劳 is toil, labour.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 拿, 提, 抬; 搬 is to move things.
般 (bān) gives the sound exactly: 搬 bān.
缶 (clay jar) — marks pots and jars, as in 罐 jar, 缸 vat; a chipped jar is 缺, lacking.
夬 (guài/jué) is a loose hint for quē; 决 jué and 快 kuài share it.
